status.description:
Current execution status

* `not_started` - not_started
* `queued` - queued
* `in_progress` - in_progress
* `completed` - completed
* `failed` - failed
* `cancelled` - cancelled

branch.description: Git branch name to associate with the task

stage.description: Current stage of the run (e.g. research, plan, build)

state_remove_keys.description: State keys to remove atomically before applying any state updates.

environment.description:
Transition a cloud run to local. Use the resume_in_cloud action to move a run into cloud.

* `local` - local
